About
Clixter

Founded in January 2026, Clixter was built on one belief: every brand has a story worth telling — and it deserves to be told beautifully.

We're a full-service video production house with an in-house team covering every stage of the filmmaking process — scriptwriting, direction, cinematography, and editing — all under one roof. That means no gaps, no miscommunication between vendors, and no compromise on quality. From the first line of the script to the final color grade, one unified creative vision carries through.

We specialize in cinematic video promotion — content that doesn't just advertise, it moves people. Brand films, product launches, social campaigns, corporate stories: every project is treated like a short film, with intentional framing, real emotional arcs, and a level of craft that makes brands look and feel premium.
